capturedFrom: http://localhost:3300 dev server. Lip and blepharoplasty from the ungated /demo route; rhinoplasty from /simulate/rhinoplasty with the repo e2e auth pattern (signed session cookie, mocked GET access routes). Every non-GET request to /api/ was aborted, so nothing was saved and no image left the page.
framing: Front pairs are the simulator's own 1024x1024 output from a 1024 source and the side pair is 1200x1200 from a 1200 source; nothing upscaled. Overlays are cropped screenshots of the simulator canvas. Cases are the same square crop of before and after around the nose, taken from the simulator's own output (1024x1024 front, 1200x1200 side) with no resampling.

pairs.controlsNote: Before is every control at neutral. Slider positions tip -30 and nostrils -30 on the -100 to 100 scale, with dorsal width left at neutral; the after readouts are exactly what the sliders print. Captured from the surgeon session of /simulate/rhinoplasty on a local production build of this branch.

overlays.drawn: The untouched before frame with the Alar/IC Ratio layer on, captured at device scale 3 and cropped to the nose. Cropping only; nothing redrawn.

notProduced.hairline-lowering: Held back: the drawn hairline lands 400 to 480 px down the frame, which is eye level on this portrait (the blepharoplasty change sits in the same band). Needs a check of the hairline simulator before it is shown. Captured at How Much to Lower 3.0 cm; the files were not kept.
notProduced.rhinoplasty-low-bridge: Held back: on three AI profiles, Dorsal Height toward Larger (0.8 to 3.2mm, with and without Tip Projection) adds a rounded bulge at the lower dorsum just above the supratip while the radix stays low, so the after reads as an added hump, not a raised bridge. Needs a look at the augmentation direction of the simulator before it is shown.
notProduced.rhinoplasty-crooked: Held back: Deviation correction mostly moves the middle of the bridge. On the one AI face it straightened cleanly (crk-a, -40, ← 1.2mm) the lean is so mild that before and after look alike at page size; on faces whose whole line runs diagonally it bends the upper bridge into an S. Needs a face with a clear C-shaped bridge.

cases.controlsNote: Before is every control at neutral. Slider position size -55 on the -100 to 100 scale; the after readout is exactly what the slider prints. Captured from the surgeon session of /simulate/rhinoplasty, from the whole generated frame resized to 1200. Levels -40 (Smaller 1.6mm) and -70 (Smaller 2.8mm) were also captured; -55 reads as a straight dorsum at phone size. A small step at the radix end shows only at about 3x zoom. The crop starts 110 px in, so the 1 to 2 px sliver the size control leaves at the left frame edge is outside it.
